title: Life Processes
summary: Grade 10: how organisms get and digest food, release energy, transport materials and remove wastes.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Organ systems work together to take in, transform and move materials, keeping the body in balance.

factual: How is aerobic respiration different from anaerobic?
conceptual: Why do larger organisms need transport systems?
How is structure related to function in the villi, alveoli and nephrons?
debatable: Should organ donation be opt-out by default?
